text:
sasha: Heads-up — found a couple of dead images under the runtime guide (kv-cache section). images 'cache-flow.png' and 'kv-lifecycle.png' return 403s when loaded. Anyone on docs sprint can pick these up?

maya: Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the failing URLs? I can try a quick rehost if needed. :eyes:

sasha: Sure — here's one quick curl check:
```
curl -I https://docs.redwood-inference.com/runtime/kv-cache/cache-flow.png
HTTP/2 403
content-type: text/html; charset=UTF-8
content-length: 345
```
Also same error for `/runtime/kv-cache/kv-lifecycle.png`.

devon: I can take cache-flow.png. Where are the original assets stored? Looks like the shortlink points to an internal bucket.

sasha: Original path is `s3://redwood-docs-prod/assets/runtime/kv-cache/`. I think the bucket policy changed during last infra cleanup.

docs-bot: [scan] Link-scan detected 2 asset failures in `/runtime/kv-cache/` — ticket DOC-412 created.

maya: I'll grab kv-lifecycle.png and rehost to the CDN-backed bucket under `public-docs/assets/runtime/kv-cache/`. I'll also add an alt text tweak — currently alt is empty. Will open a PR and tag for review.

samir: Quick note — rehosting will need a shortlink redirect so existing permalinks don't break. I can add a 301 rule in the CDN once files are live.

maya: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2805 — rehost + alt fix. @devon can you review when free? :pray:
devon: On it. Quick Q: do we preserve original filenames or append a hash for cache-busting?
sasha: Prefer keeping the original names to avoid breaking any anchors or external references. For cache-busting, add a query param via CDN cache invalidation when we update.
samir: I'll prepare the redirect entry. Example command I'll run after PR merges: `aws s3 cp kv-lifecycle.png s3://public-docs/assets/runtime/kv-cache/kv-lifecycle.png --acl public-read` then invalidate `/assets/runtime/kv-cache/*` in the CDN.
deponly: (bot noise suppressed)
deploy-bot: cdn-sync job kicked for staging assets — job 2026-03-20-09:21 started.
maya: CI is green on #2805 — merging now. Will ping again once CDN rule is active.
devon: Reviewed and left a tiny nit about alt wording; pushed a fix.
samir: CDN rule added and staging validation looks good: `curl -I https://staging-docs.redwood.com/assets/runtime/kv-cache/kv-lifecycle.png` returns `HTTP/2 200`.
sasha: Amazing — thank you all. Marking DOC-412 as resolved on my side. Closing out once prod sync runs. :tada:
